summary: Wave 98 (compact dealer grid + clickable cards + Phase-1/Phase-2 split + admin bulk dealer onboarding) backend tested end-to-end and frontend verified via code review. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass against the live preview URL — POST /api/admin/dealers/bulk-create (unauth=401, empty=zero-counts, single valid row creates user + suppliers_pending row, EXISTING email is skipped while a sibling new row in the same file is still created, same email twice in one file yields skipped_duplicate_in_file=1), POST /api/auth/supplier-phase2 unauth=401, POST /api/auth/apply-seller with Phase-1 fields only (no business_address, no bank, no docs) returns 200 (was 422 pre-Wave98). Compact toner grid 'grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5' confirmed in SupplierDashboard.jsx:1062 with openDetail navigate('/toner/{id}') on line 1075 and stopPropagation on inline price/edit/dup/del wrappers (lines 1092, 1099, 1110). PrinterListings.jsx:213-253, PaperListings.jsx:217-244, ConsumableListings.jsx:192-228, ScannerListings.jsx:192-228 all carry the same compact grid + navigate(`/printer/{id}` etc.) + stopPropagation pattern. The on-card 'Compatible: ...' line is no longer rendered (toner_type === 'Compatible' label remains, which is the badge text — not the model list). The fix for the email-validator '@example.test' rejection was applied in the pytest file (use @example.com); created QA dealers are cleaned up best-effort via /api/admin/dealers/{id}/delete and sibling fallbacks after each test.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py admin_bulk_create_dealers loops sequentially and calls sb_admin.auth.admin.create_user + table.upsert + auth.admin.generate_link + email_dealer_welcome_magic for every new row. For a CSV of ~100 dealers this could take 30-60s in one request and risks Cloudflare/edge timeout. Consider chunking + a background task (FastAPI BackgroundTasks or a job queue), and stream progress over WS or return a job_id the admin can poll.

routes/admin.py:1579 does a full sb_admin.table('users').select('email').execute() with no limit as the 'capitalised variants' fallback. This loads every user row on every bulk-create request — fine at 50 users, will hurt at 50k. Replace with .ilike() per email or a single in_() that lower-cases server-side.

routes/admin.py:1605 — on auth.create_user failure the partial Supabase auth user is NOT rolled back (only the failed row is recorded). If create_user actually succeeded but raised after, the row is orphaned and the email is now 'existing' on retry. Wrap with a try/except that calls sb_admin.auth.admin.delete_user(uid) on later-step failure to keep retries idempotent.

routes/auth.py:391 — for non-supplier role the endpoint writes Phase-2 fields to suppliers_pending without checking if a pending row exists for the user; if the row doesn't exist the update silently affects 0 rows but still returns {ok:true,target:'pending'}. Add a .maybe_single() pre-check or an upsert with user_id so a customer without a pending application receives a 404/400 instead of a misleading success.

SupplierDashboard.jsx is now ~1540 lines (still above the 700-line review threshold). Splitting the four tab bodies (Toners / Printers / Papers / Consumables / Scanners) into separate route-level components remains recommended.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 98 backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_wave98_bulk_dealers_phase2.py (7 cases, ~18s runtime, requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). KEY GOTCHA: Pydantic EmailStr rejects '@example.test' as a reserved TLD — always use '@example.com' for QA dealer emails in this codebase. The phone-number uniqueness check on /api/auth/apply-seller is strict ('9876543210' is already taken) — use a random 10-digit phone. Supplier-phase2 success path was code-reviewed only because a fresh approved-supplier account isn't shared; if needed, register via /api/auth/signup-supplier then approve via POST /api/admin/suppliers/{pending_id}/approve, login to get token, then PUT bank fields. The /login form on the live frontend does NOT call /api/auth/login on the browser side — appears to use the Supabase JS client. To automate admin/supplier UI tests, either inject a Supabase session via localStorage or run after a manual login.
rca of the issue: No defects found. The single-row create test initially failed because /api/admin/suppliers (approved list) doesn't include the just-created PENDING dealer; switched to verifying via the API's own created_rows[].user_id response which is the right contract. The apply-seller test initially returned 409 because the demo phone '9876543210' was already used by a real dealer — fixed by using a per-run random 10-digit phone. Both fixes are in /app/backend/tests/test_wave98_bulk_dealers_phase2.py.
